categories.main_business_segments: Shennan Circuits Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: printed circuit boards (PCBs), electronic assembly, and packaging substrates. The company has developed a unique '3-In-One' business model integrating these segments, covering the entire value chain from design, manufacturing, assembly, micro-assembly to testing. It serves as a leading player in China's electronic circuit industry and a pioneer in packaging substrates.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in high-end PCB design and manufacturing, including multilayer boards, high-frequency microwave boards, HDI boards, and metal-based boards. It also develops advanced packaging substrates such as FC-BGA and FC-CSP using wire bonding and flip-chip technologies. Production methods include through-hole technology, surface mount technology, and microelectronic packaging, supported by digital and intelligent manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading enterprises in telecommunications, data centers, automotive electronics, industrial control, and medical electronics. The company focuses on markets driven by AI computing power, high-speed network communications, and automotive electrification and intelligence. Major end markets are wireless base stations, servers, storage devices, automotive radar and sensors, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shennan Circuits operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Wuxi, Nantong, Guangzhou, and overseas facilities in the USA, Thailand, Germany, and Hong Kong. Its sales cover domestic and international markets, with significant export sales denominated in USD, EUR, and other currencies. The company is expanding its overseas footprint, including a new factory in Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across upstream to downstream segments of the electronic interconnection supply chain. It manufactures PCBs and packaging substrates (upstream and midstream) and provides electronic assembly and system integration services (downstream). This integrated approach enables it to offer comprehensive one-stop solutions from samples to mass production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Shennan Circuits prioritizes technology leadership and innovation, investing over 7% of revenue in R&D focused on next-generation communication, data center, and automotive electronics PCB technologies. Key R&D directions include high-speed, high-frequency, high-density interconnection, advanced packaging substrates (FC-BGA, FC-CSP), and RF substrate technologies. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to enhance operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of printed circuit boards, packaging substrates, and electronic assembly services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to large strategic customers. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods or services, with contracts including VMI and non-VMI sales models domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shennan Circuits is ranked 4th globally among PCB manufacturers by revenue according to Prismark reports. It is the largest domestic supplier of packaging substrates in China and a leading supplier of wireless base station RF PCBs. The company holds a strong competitive position due to its integrated '3-In-One' business model, advanced technology, and stable relationships with global leading customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total revenue of approximately RMB 17.9 billion, a 32.39% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.88 billion, up 34.29%. Total assets reached RMB 25.3 billion, growing 11.92% from the previous year. The company maintains a healthy growth trajectory supported by expanding market demand and capacity ramp-up.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shennan Circuits emphasizes its unique integrated business model combining PCB, packaging substrates, and electronic assembly, enabling efficient collaboration and comprehensive solutions. Its products feature high precision, high density, high frequency, and advanced packaging capabilities tailored for AI, 5G, automotive, and data center applications. The company’s strong R&D, quality management, and digital manufacturing capabilities differentiate it as a technology leader and reliable partner for global customers.
